name: Kazhetsya, nikogda...
source:
"Sometimes people who cannot walk grow wings and never touch the ground again. What could possibly keep them in the sky? Perhaps it is chance, or something more down-to-earth?
When a fairy tale intersects with the real world, what will you or I have to choose?
And so, I choose!.."

A story about Semyon, who lost himself in the autumn and decided that nothing could help him anymore. He searched for a way out through other people, but in the end...
A sweet story about how cycles don't just exist in Sovyonok; that life, no matter how unfair it might be, will give everyone a chance if they only make the right choice. One day, we will all stand before a mirror and say to ourselves: "I choose!"

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3032606637]Steam[/url]]
